# proxmox_cluster_metrics_server (Resource)

Manages a Proxmox VE Graphite, InfluxDB, or OpenTelemetry metrics server through `/cluster/metrics/server/{id}`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

resource "proxmox_cluster_metrics_server" "influx" {
  server_id          = "influx-main"
  type               = "influxdb"
  server             = "influx.example.com"
  port               = 8086
  influxdb_protocol  = "https"
  organization       = "infrastructure"
  bucket             = "proxmox"
  token              = var.influxdb_token
  verify_certificate = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `port` (Number) Server network port.
- `server` (String) Server DNS name or IP address.
- `server_id` (String) Stable metrics server identifier. Changes require replacement.
- `type` (String) Plugin type: `graphite`, `influxdb`, or `opentelemetry`. Changes require replacement.

### Optional

- `api_path_prefix` (String) InfluxDB API path prefix for reverse proxies.
- `bucket` (String) InfluxDB v2 bucket or database.
- `disable` (Boolean) Disable metrics transmission.
- `graphite_path` (String) Root Graphite path.
- `graphite_protocol` (String) Graphite transport protocol: `udp` or `tcp`.
- `graphite_timeout` (Number) Graphite TCP socket timeout in seconds.
- `influxdb_protocol` (String) InfluxDB protocol: `udp`, `http`, or `https`.
- `max_body_size` (Number) InfluxDB maximum batched request body size in bytes.
- `mtu` (Number) MTU for UDP metrics transmission.
- `opentelemetry_compression` (String) OpenTelemetry request compression: `none` or `gzip`.
- `opentelemetry_headers` (String, Sensitive) Base64-encoded JSON OpenTelemetry HTTP headers.
- `opentelemetry_max_body_size` (Number) OpenTelemetry maximum request body size in bytes.
- `opentelemetry_path` (String) OpenTelemetry endpoint path.
- `opentelemetry_protocol` (String) OpenTelemetry HTTP protocol: `http` or `https`.
- `opentelemetry_resource_attributes` (String) Base64-encoded JSON OpenTelemetry resource attributes.
- `opentelemetry_timeout` (Number) OpenTelemetry request timeout in seconds.
- `opentelemetry_verify_ssl` (Boolean) Verify TLS certificates for OpenTelemetry HTTPS endpoints.
- `organization` (String) InfluxDB v2 organization.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) InfluxDB access token. The API does not return this value.
- `verify_certificate` (Boolean) Verify certificates for InfluxDB HTTPS endpoints.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Metrics server identifier.
